description: Updates a line item and recomputes the parent planned_amount.

200.description: Updated line item with parent planned_amount

percentage.description: Markup rate when amount_type is percentage — "10.0000" means 10%.

calculated_total.description: Read-only. For percentage rows this is derived from the sum of the non-percentage rows and is never stored.

503.description: The permission check could not be completed (`AUTHORIZATION_UNAVAILABLE`) — safe to retry

amount.description: Used when amount_type is flat. Send null to clear it.

quantity.description: Used when amount_type is unit_quantity. Send null to clear it.

unit_cost.description: Used when amount_type is unit_quantity. Send null to clear it.

percentage.description: Used when amount_type is percentage — "10.0000" means 10%. Must be between 0 and 100. Send null to clear it.

position.description: New display order. Neighboring items are rebalanced automatically.
